passage.label: Indeed righteous pleasure; wicked Hellfire; enter burn Day Recompense; never therefrom absent; what make know Day Recompense; then what make know Day Recompense; Day soul not possess another soul power thing; command Day entirely Allah

arabicExcerpts.text: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ

mainSubject.label: The righteous placed in pleasure while the wicked are in Hellfire, entering to burn on the Day of Recompense from which they will never be absent; the gravity of that Day emphasised by doubled questioning; it is the Day when no soul possesses any power for another and the command rests entirely with Allah

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the soul-knowing verdict (5) before the deception-question opens (6); P2 ends with the recording-keepers' knowledge (12) before the two-outcome block begins (13); P3 runs through pleasure-versus-Hellfire, the doubled Day-of-Recompense question and the closing absolute-sovereignty statement (13-19).
